              1-Click to Take a Screenshot
            </div>

              Even for entire page!
            </div>
</div>

<div class="pic"></div>
<div class="text">
              Annotate a Screenshot
            </div>
<div class="text-tip">
              With various editing options
            </div>
</div>
<div class="work-item share">
<div class="pic"></div>
<div class="text">
              Share a Screenshot
            </div>
<div class="text-tip">
              To multiple destinations
            </div>
</div>

<div class="content">This tool has a really smooth select and capture feature that allows you to quickly zoom in and out, capture, mark up and save selected areas and save your image in a matter of seconds.<br/><br/>It is fast enough to let you share and annotate anything you are discussing over chat video conf. Just used it to take snapshots of small msitakes and make annotations for our web developer. Now,I have a permanent record of final change requests before sign off.</div>
